form.label: Configuration
form.description: Find the index that holds the data of TA_hpe_aruba_central and set the macro aruba_central_index. No restart needed.

div.h3: 1. Find the index that holds the Aruba Central data
div.p: This app only shows data that the add-on TA_hpe_aruba_central has collected. The search below looks at the last 24 hours and lists the indexes that contain its sourcetypes (aruba:central:*). If it finds nothing, install and configure the add-on first.

table.title: Candidate indexes for Aruba Central data (sourcetype=aruba:central:*)

search.query: | metasearch index=* sourcetype=aruba:central:* | stats count by index, sourcetype | sort - count

div.p: Enter the full search expression, for example index=aruba or (index=aruba OR index=network). The current value is pre-filled.
div.label: aruba_central_index
div.p: The macro is stored in local/macros.conf of this app. It applies to all dashboards immediately.

table.title: 3. Check: events per sourcetype with the saved macro (last 24 hours)

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype=aruba:central:* | stats count, latest(_time) as latest by sourcetype | eval latest=strftime(latest, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - count
